description: Storage Replica and SharePoint Setup backend controller completion. The Storage Replica endpoint in VmsController currently returns an empty list. The SharePoint Setup controller already has a working execute endpoint but no status/progress reporting. Implement proper backend logic for both.
steps: Create src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/StorageReplicaController.cs - a dedicated controller at route 'api/servers/{serverId}/storage-replica' with full CRUD: GET (list partnerships via PowerShell Get-SRPartnership), POST (create via New-SRPartnership), PUT {id} (update settings via Set-SRPartnership), DELETE {id} (remove via Remove-SRPartnership), POST {id}/swap (Set-SRPartnership -NewSourceComputerName), POST {id}/failover (Mount-SRDestination), POST {id}/toggle-pause (Suspend-SRPartnership or Resume-SRPartnership), POST {id}/resync (Sync-SRGroup). Each action uses IPowerShellExecutionService. Return the ReplicaPartnership model.

Create src/Nexus.Gateway/Models/StorageReplicaModels.cs with ReplicaPartnershipDto matching the frontend's ReplicaPartnership interface (id, sourceServer, destServer, sourceVol, destVol, sourceLogVol, destLogVol, mode, status, progress, bytes, latencyMs, transferRateMbps, name, replicationGroup, logSizeGb, encryption, autoFailover)
Remove the stub storage-replica endpoint from src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/VmsController.cs (the GetStorageReplica method that returns empty list)

Add to src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/SharePointSetupController.cs: GET /api/plugins/SharePointSetup/status endpoint that returns the status of running SharePoint deployment jobs by querying PluginBackgroundJobManager for jobs with 'sharepoint_' prefix, GET /api/plugins/SharePointSetup/logs/{jobId} endpoint that returns logs for a specific SP job

Update the CreateReplicaPartnershipDto in frontend's client.ts to match the new backend model (update the ReplicaPartnership interface to include the additional fields: sourceVol, destVol, sourceLogVol, destLogVol, mode, progress, bytes, latencyMs, transferRateMbps, name, replicationGroup, logSizeGb, encryption, autoFailover)
acceptance_criteria: StorageReplicaController exists with full CRUD and action endpoints
StorageReplicaModels.cs has complete DTO matching frontend interface
VmsController no longer has the stub storage-replica endpoint
SharePointSetupController has status and logs endpoints
Frontend ReplicaPartnership interface in client.ts matches backend DTO
Frontend builds successfully with bun run build
verification: cd src/Nexus.Frontend && bun install && bun run build
findings: All acceptance criteria met. StorageReplicaController created with 8 endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, swap, failover, toggle-pause, resync). StorageReplicaModels.cs has full DTO. VmsController stub removed. SharePointSetupController has status and logs endpoints. Frontend ReplicaPartnership interface updated with all fields used by storage-replica.tsx. Frontend builds cleanly with bun run build.
